content.text:
All clean. The fix is on line 519 of `setup.go` in `setupAgentHooksNonInteractive`. When `LoadEntireSettings()` fails, the fallback struct now initializes `Strategy` to `strategy.DefaultStrategyName` (`"manual-commit"`) instead of leaving it as an empty string. This prevents the confusing "unknown strategy: " error when `--strategy` isn't provided.

The other two occurrences of this pattern (lines 228 and 331) don't need fixing because they immediately overwrite `settings.Strategy = internalStrategy` on the next line.
